tagline: A global leader in life sciences, diagnostics and applied markets
hero_kpi_rationale: This segment is Agilent's main growth engine, contributing 11% growth in 2025, driven by the BIOVECTRA acquisition and demand for molecular and clinical solutions, making it the central strategic lever.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue — total sales generated over the period.
kpis.description: Total revenue grew 7% in 2025 to $6.948 billion, after a 5% decline in 2024. Growth is driven by all segments and regions, with a positive effect from the BIOVECTRA acquisition.

kpis.name: Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the Life Sciences and Diagnostics segment.
kpis.description: This segment, newly formed in November 2024, combines diagnostics, genomics and liquid chromatography. It shows 11% growth in 2025, driven by demand for clinical and molecular solutions.

kpis.name: Agilent CrossLab Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the Agilent CrossLab segment.
kpis.description: The CrossLab segment, which includes services, consumables and software, grew 6% in 2025, after +3% in 2024, showing stable demand for maintenance and automation solutions.

kpis.name: Applied Markets Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the Applied Markets segment.
kpis.description: This segment, affected in 2024 by the decline in customer capex spending, slightly rebounds in 2025 with +1%, despite an unfavorable currency effect.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net Income — bottom-line profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income reaches $1.303 billion in 2025, up from $1.289 billion in 2024, thanks to tax relief.

kpis.name: Cash and Cash Equivalents
kpis.explanation: Liquidity available to finance operations or invest.
kpis.description: Cash reaches $1.789 billion in October 2025, up from $1.329 billion a year earlier, strengthening the capacity to invest or buy back shares.

company_description: Agilent Technologies, Inc. provides application focused solutions to the life sciences, diagnostics, and applied chemical markets worldwide. The company operates through three segments: Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets, Agilent CrossLab, and Applied Markets. The Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets segment offers liquid chromatography systems and components; and liquid chromatography mass spectrometry systems. This segment is also involved in the genomics, contract development and manufacturing organization, pathology, companion diagnostics, and biomolecular analysis businesses. The Agilent CrossLab segment provides various services, including repairs, parts, maintenance, installations, training, compliance support, software as a service, asset management, consulting, and other custom services.
